Travel — a flat trip fee by zone

Based from Steele Creek. A cross-town drop and a cross-metro haul shouldn’t cost the same, so the drive is priced honestly instead of buried in the rate.

No feeZone 1 — Core

Charlotte (S/SW), Steele Creek, Pineville, Lake Wylie, Tega Cay

+$29Zone 2 — Near

+$49Zone 3 — Metro

Delivery and hauling bill at the crew rate plus travel. Travel is the zone trip fee plus $3.00 per loaded mile beyond the first 10 miles of the haul.

By how much space the load takes in our 16ft trailer. A single item is $95, an eighth of the trailer $150, a quarter $235, a half $395, and a full trailer $700. Mattresses are +$25 each and refrigerant appliances +$40. Confirmed on-site before we start.

Yes — 16 cities including Fort Mill, Rock Hill, Huntersville, Concord, Mooresville, Matthews, Pineville, Ballantyne, Mount Holly, Gastonia, Waxhaw, Stallings, Indian Trail, Tega Cay, and Lake Wylie.

Always free — and often you don’t need one. TV mounting, handyman, and moving run on published rates we can quote over the phone. Junk removal, hauling, and flooring get a free on-site look because price depends on volume or square footage.

TV mounting is flat by size: $99 up to 60″, $149 for 61–75″, $199 for 76–85″, and a custom quote for 86″ and up. Over-fireplace and stone start at $199, and each additional TV in the same visit is 25% off the mount labor. Handyman is $70/hr and a two-person crew $135/hr, both two-hour minimums, with a three-hour minimum on weekend crew bookings. A trailer adds +$35/hr (utility) or +$60/hr (16ft enclosed). Junk removal runs $95 to $700 by trailer space, and flooring is $2.50/sq ft installed.

Yes — one of our most common jobs. Over-fireplace, stone, and brick installs start at $199. In-wall cord concealment is from $89, or $39 for a renter-friendly stick-on raceway. Cord concealment is priced separately and isn’t discounted by the multi-TV rate.

Send anyone our way — a friend, a neighbor, family — and have them mention your name when they book. Once their first job is complete, they get $25 off that invoice and you get a $25 credit toward your next service. Three booked referrals earns you $100 in credit or a free hour of solo labor.
